templates.subject: Connection Request
templates.body: Hi [Name], I notice you work extensively with businesses in the [Region/Industry] area. I specialize in helping companies optimize their capital structure through non-dilutive funding. I'd love to connect and see if I can be a resource for your clients who are looking to scale without giving up equity.

templates.subject: Mutual Client Value / Funding Resource
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

I'm reaching out because I help business owners secure growth capital that traditional banks often overlook. 

Since you handle the tax and advisory side for your clients, you likely see the 'capital gap' first-hand. I’d like to introduce Moonshine Capital as a secondary tool in your belt for when your clients need equipment financing or bridge loans to get to the next level.

Do you have 10 minutes next Tuesday for a brief intro call?

Best,
[Your Name]

templates.subject: Monthly Check-in
templates.body: Hey [Name], just calling to see how tax season is treating you. I just closed a deal for a client in [Industry] that saved them about 15% on their monthly debt service—made me think of your portfolio. Any of your clients currently looking at expansion plans for the next quarter?

templates.subject: Helping your buyers close faster
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

I see your current listings for [Company Name/Industry]. I know SBA timelines can often kill a deal or frustrate a seller.

I specialize in bridge financing and creative capital that can close in as little as 7 days. I’d love to be your 'Plan B' for buyers who are hitting a wall with traditional lending so you can get your commissions paid on time.

Can we chat briefly this week?

Best,
[Your Name]

templates.subject: Follow up on structure
templates.body: Great chatting today, [Name]. I've attached our standard referral fee schedule. For that $2M acquisition we discussed, we can likely structure a gap-fund to cover the down payment requirement. Let's get this deal across the finish line.

templates.subject: Turning your 'No's' into 'Yes's'
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

As a commercial banker, I know how frustrating it is to tell a great local business owner that they don't quite fit the bank's current credit box.

At Moonshine Capital, we love the deals banks can't do yet. I’d like to be the person you refer those clients to. They get the funding they need now, and they stay loyal to you for their treasury and operating accounts because you provided a solution.

Are you open to a quick coffee nearby to discuss a referral flow?

Best,
[Your Name]

templates.subject: Closing the Sale
templates.body: Hi [Name], I'm following up on that client who was looking at the [Equipment Model]. If they are hesitating because of the cash outlay, I can get them an equipment lease approval by tomorrow morning. It keeps their cash in the bank and gets your inventory moved. Should I send over the application link?
